Weekly mean of daily mean surface pressure from ERA5-Land, single grid-cell extraction at the QC centroid. The source feed stops after week 2025-39; weeks 2025-40 through 2025-52 are left blank rather than estimated. See FLAG_PRESSURE_SH_GAP.

Weekly mean saturation vapor pressure, computed from ERA5-Land mean temperature using a standard Tetens-type formula. Depends only on temperature, so it covers the full 2010-2025 span with no gap even where Pressure_ERA5-Land is blank.

Weekly mean actual vapor pressure, computed from ERA5-Land saturation vapor pressure and relative humidity. Depends only on temperature and relative humidity, so it covers the full 2010-2025 span with no gap.

Weekly mean specific humidity derived from ERA5-Land temperature, relative humidity and surface pressure. QC Data values are computed from the daily inputs using a standard saturation-vapor-pressure formula; Regional and Multi-Setting Data values were supplied pre-computed by the source file. Blank for QC weeks after 2025-39, matching the Pressure_ERA5-Land gap, since specific humidity (unlike the vapor pressure terms above) requires pressure as an input.

Weekly mean of daily mean air temperature from PAGASA station observations. Available from week 2018-52 (partial, 3 of 7 days) through 2025-39; the exact station is not identified in the source file. Four days in March 2021 carried a -999 sentinel value in the source and were excluded rather than averaged in. The source file does not provide daily minimum/maximum temperature, so no PAGASA temperature extremes column exists.
Weekly mean of daily relative humidity from PAGASA station observations, same coverage and exclusions as Temp_PAGASA. The source file does not provide daily minimum/maximum relative humidity.

Weekly mean actual vapor pressure computed from PAGASA station temperature and relative humidity, same coverage and exclusions as Temp_PAGASA.
Weekly mean specific humidity computed from PAGASA temperature and relative humidity together with ERA5-Land surface pressure as the third input, same coverage and exclusions as Temp_PAGASA.

Weekly mean of daily minimum 2 m air temperature from NASA MERRA-2, setting-level series. Represents the average daily low across the week, not the single lowest reading.

Weekly mean specific humidity from NASA MERRA-2, setting-level series. The source file contains corrupted daily values (on the order of 1e14 g/kg or larger, physically impossible) for six of the eight settings; corrupted days were dropped before averaging rather than included. Coverage loss by setting: Colombia under 1%, Philippines about 5%, Taiwan about 19%, Singapore about 70%. Brazil, Mexico, Peru and Sri Lanka were unaffected. See FLAG_MERRA2_SH_LOW_COVERAGE. The source file does not provide daily minimum/maximum specific humidity.
